scripts.typecheck: effect-tsgo tsrs -p tsconfig.json && effect-tsgo tsrs -p src/solid/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: effect-tsgo --tsrs-lint oxlint -c ../../packages/lint/oxlintrc.json src/spar src/foldkit src/shared scripts
scripts.build: vite build --config vite.spar.config.ts && vite build --config vite.solid.config.ts && vite build --config vite.foldkit.config.ts
scripts.allocations: vite build --config vite.spar.config.ts --minify false --outDir ../../dist-readable/spar && bun scripts/allocations.ts
